title: A_Shfox's Currency
description: A very simple but sophisticated currency mod. including coins and cash.
body:
![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cedf6aeb7bc05dde7f8d0774f8fb4d452db26420.png)


Another mod, another mod summary for you to read:

This one's easy, you have 5 tiers of coins[iron, gold , emerald , diamond and netherite], inspired by the game Terraria, each coin can be made and also turned into the other higher or lower values, 9-->1 and so on. There is also currently 2 ways of portable cash storage and coin storage and a tool used for making said coins. for more info check screenshots and as always use JEI or EMI.



 

Great for quest rewards, even better for servers and scenarios.

 
made using mcreator, hate it if you wanna*
 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Can you use it in a modpack?  ofc you can!
